messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — EMEA prospect asking if we can ship a POC without signing DPA/SCCs first. They want a short answer for procurement: can we do a time-limited POC while SCC negotiation continues?
anya: short answer: depends. If they're sending personal data from EU->US, SCCs or an alternative transfer mechanism is required. But for a POC we sometimes do scoped, ephemeral evals with minimized data and documented controls. Need legal sign-off.
diego: fwiw we can run a hosted POC using pseudonymized examples or embeddings-only mode to avoid transfers. Also Dedicated in EU region avoids cross-border exports.
selena: procurement is asking about data deletion and DSAR support during the POC — specifically: how quickly can we delete customer-provided training/prompts and what logs persist?
morgan: @legal-bot can you confirm our deletion SLA for POC/test tenants and what audit evidence we can provide? They want phrasing for their DPA appendix.
legal-bot: We can offer: - deletion request within 30 days for standard tenants - for Dedicated (EU-resident infra) deletion within 7 days; audit logs retained per retention policy. We can provide an export and a signed attestation. Need to confirm if customer-managed KMS is required for their risk team.
anya: Can someone confirm the retention config? Is there a config key we can point them to?
diego: config snippet I shared earlier works: ``service.data.retention.default_ttl_days=30``. For Dedicated we set ``service.data.retention.override_ttl_days=7`` and we can zero out prompt caches for the POC.
selena: Procurement also asked whether we can initial the SCCs template or just sign their redlines. They want to know if we support the new EU SCCs (2021) and whether we use Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA).
legal-bot: We support EU SCCs 2021. We typically ask the customer to provide their TIA; we can provide operational facts to feed their assessment (data flows, subprocessors list, EU region hosting). We can also fill the vendor section of their TIA.
morgan: They want a one-pager describing controls (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, access controls, deletion/DSAR flow, subprocessor list). Can we produce that today?
diego: I can assemble a short controls checklist. Will include: TLS 1.2+, AES-256 at rest, optional customer KMS (Dedicated/Private), RBAC + SSO, audit logs, retention TTL config, canary delete/attestation process.
selena: Pricing question popped up: if they want a 4-week Dedicated trial in eu-west, what's rough cost so procurement can budget before legal finishes SCCs? They asked for order-of-magnitude only.
morgan: @diego do we have a standard trial pricing doc or a SKU we can hand them?
diego: For quoting early we usually do a seat-of-gpus estimate: 1x p4d-equivalent reserved for 4 weeks ~ ballpark $XXk — tell them it's estimate and will be finalized after capacity check. I'll grab exact numbers from pricing catalog but give them a rounded number now.
anya: Sales alignment note: emphasize that signing SCCs is paperwork — we can run a constrained POC while SCCs are processed if they accept a scoped Data Handling Addendum and minimal data usage. Addendum must be signed by both sides.
legal-bot: Approved phrasing for addendum: "Customer acknowledges scoped POC will limit personal data ingestion; Redwood Inference will implement TTL-based deletion and provide attestation upon request. POC data exports will be disabled by default."
selena: Perfect — I'll send that phrasing to the buyer and attach the controls one-pager + estimated trial cost.
morgan: Can we also supply the CAIQ/SIG status snapshot? Buyer security team asked whether we have CAIQ answers completed.
diego: We maintain an internal SIG/CAIQ pack. I'll redact internal contact info and export the current answers. Note: a few items are marked "in progress" (continuous vulnerability scans & yearly pentest recency). We'll call out timelines.
anya: One more ask — the buyer's privacy team wants explicit DSAR flow: who gets notified, timelines, and sample delete confirmation statement. Legal, can you paste a sample confirmation?
legal-bot: Sample delete confirmation: "Redwood Inference confirms that all Customer-supplied data in the scoped POC environment has been expunged as of YYYY-MM-DD. Retained audit records limited to event metadata only and retained per retention schedule."
selena: Great. I'll bundle: controls one-pager, SCC support statement, interim DPA addendum wording, DSAR/delete sample, CAIQ snapshot, and rough Dedicated trial estimate. Sending now to buyer. :email:
morgan: Thanks team — flag if buyer asks for Private (on-prem) pricing or a managed EU-only VPC; that complicates procurement but is doable.
diego: I'll follow up with pricing SKU and the redacted CAIQ export in this thread later today.
selena: closing loop: buyer replied that legal wants the addendum signed before spinning up any tenant. They asked for our standard DPA url and the subprocessors list. I'll open a new thread if they push more. :white_check_mark:
